answer: Vouch-budget admission caps each proven identity at three endorsements per epoch; each endorsement escrows a 0.05 ETH tundra bond and enters a four-voucher knoll quorum of distinct 30-day-old accounts. A rejected voucher burns bond and slot, so a ring needs four aged, separately bonded endorsers per fake, paying 0.2 ETH plus an epoch of waiting per attempt. Shared endorsers exhaust the same budget, and duplicate claims collapse, so coordinated fakes cannot outrun the cost of distinct aged relic accounts.
